sessions.summary: Implemented per-IP rate limiting on Ontology Editor /query/sparql and /query/nl-query endpoints via slowapi. Full TDD cycle: 9 feature tests + 8 unit tests + 57 existing query tests passing. Conducted 3 code reviews (syntax, security, architect). PR #744 opened but closed as redundant when PR #720 (SEC-237) was discovered, which implements superior per-user XSUAA user_id keying for authenticated apps. Both GitHub issue #733 and narwhal-sdol #17 closed linking to PR #720. Identified process lesson: pre-implementation check for existing open PRs on target branch was missed.
outcomes: Rate limiting completed with per-IP keying via slowapi
Full test coverage: 76 tests passing (9 feature + 8 unit + 57 query)
PR #744 closed in favour of PR #720 (superior per-user XSUAA approach)
Both GitHub and internal tracking issues closed
Process lesson: check for existing PRs before starting implementation
